description: Retrieves a mobile (virtual) credential and its assignment state for a person and card format (wraps NBAPI GetVirtualCredentialRequest). Returns CARDFORMAT, PERSONID and STATUS. A card format the controller does not know answers FAIL with "CARDFORMAT NOT FOUND"; use get_card_formats for valid names.

CARDFORMAT.description: Required. Name of the card format used to decode the credential (see get_card_formats).

PERSONID.description: Required. The PERSONID the credential is assigned to.

name: get_virtual_credential_request
